column4: Public Health Emergency
that a person provide information or answer questions
about the person’s health or other circumstances;
that a person’s health be monitored and the results
reported;
that  a  person  attend  trainig  or  advice  sessions  on
how to reduce the risk of infecting or contaminating
others;
that a person be subject to restrictions on where the
person goes or with whom the person has contact;
that a person abstain from working or trading;
that a thing be seized or retained;
in the case of a dead body, that the body be buried or
cremated;
in  any  other  case,  that  a  thing  be  destroyed  or
disposed  of;
that premises be closed;
that, in the case of a conveyance or movable structure,
the conveyance or structure be detained;
that,  in  the  case  of  a  building,  conveyance  or
structure, the premises be destroyed.
